email.body1:
Greg, saw Bitsight launched Dark Web Intelligence for Supply Chains and just landed Leader in the Forrester Wave.

Launches and analyst wins flood the top of funnel, and the bottleneck becomes follow-up volume: more in-market accounts than your reps can touch before signals go cold. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and multi-channel follow-up, so your team books 3-5x more meetings without adding headcount.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Greg, quick follow-up for the Bitsight team.

Most SDR teams lose deals not on intent but on speed: signals fire, reps are mid-sequence on something else, and the window closes. Built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 specific things I would change for the team to respond faster and ramp new reps quicker.
email.body3:
Greg, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other security software teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Greg, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If helping your reps cover more accounts without new hires isn't a focus this quarter, no problem at all. I know managing an SDR team through a product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team? I will tailor it to Bitsight either way.
